expectations.note: The live Linux debug app answered ext.nothingness calls; independent verification and inspection captured a reachable VM with playback state and registered process.
Independent pause and resume calls produced isPlaying false then true; the resume-state verification captured the playing state.
With a three-track queue, next changed the active track from index 0 to index 1 and from 01-undercover-49.opus to 02-undercover-50.opus in the captured runtime state.
While playing 02-undercover-50.opus at about 11.5s, seeking to 30s yielded about 31.7s in the captured runtime state, within tolerance and clearly forward.
The candidate's play/pause, queue, next, seek, and final values are backed by concrete extension-call outputs and inspect reads in the contiguous session event stream.
Independent runtime behavior was normal and the full inspection reported an empty git status and diff_stat; no source changes were present.
The independent runtime verification remained responsive, reported no overflow reports, and process inspection showed the Linux app alive; no unresolved crash or hang was found.
